title: JobRegisteredPayload
description: Payload of the JobRegistered platform event (INV-REQ-1226 b1-b2, INV-ADR-285; class: platform; FR-AH.15), added by owner ruling INV-Q-2981 and drafted in INV-API-3020. service-runtime emits it when a service instance starts, once per registered job, so a job that has never run is visible to console-bff and notification-svc (INV-REQ-1136, INV-REQ-1139 b5). Consumers treat it as an upsert keyed by (ownerService, job). Authored by INV-T-3007. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

job.description: The scheduled job's own name, e.g. 'scheduled-despatch' (TPL-09); unique within its owner service.

ownerService.description: The service the job runs in.

entityScope.description: PLATFORM for a job that runs once for the installation; ENTITY for a job that runs per entity, the entity given per run (INV-Q-2942). Extensible (API-09, API-41).

schedule.description: The job's registered schedule, as the job declares it (INV-REQ-1136).

criticality.description: The job's criticality as registered (INV-REQ-1136, INV-Q-2942): STANDARD, or DEADLINE_CRITICAL for a job such as scheduled submission or a readiness drain whose pause is bounded by the entity's nearest due date minus its safety margin (INV-REQ-1138 b3). Extensible (API-09, API-41).

tolerance.description: How late a run may be before it counts as missed, an ISO-8601 duration; mandatory at registration (INV-REQ-1136 b1, INV-REQ-1139, rulings INV-Q-2067, INV-Q-2942).
